verdict.rationale: Warp documents typing '#' on the command line and describing the task in natural language, with AI Command Suggestions loading as you type and the matching command generated in place in real time (warp-docs-8, warp-docs-54). A daily user independently praises 'AI generated commands at your fingertips' (warp-comm-8). The feature is now labeled 'Generate (Legacy)', which suggests it is being deprioritized in favor of Agent Mode. Missing for 10: hands-on corroboration that the generated commands are reliably correct, and clarity on the long-term support status of the Legacy feature.
